verses.sloka: ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवः तान् हरीन् दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ।अब्रवित् मेघ संकाशम् सुशेषणम् नाम वानरम् ॥४-४२-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvaḥ tān harīn dakṣiṇām diśam ।abravit megha saṁkāśam suśeṣaṇam nāma vānaram ॥4-42-1॥

translations.english: After sending the monkeys in the southern direction, Sugriva said to the cloudlike troop leader called Sushena.
translations.hindi: किष्किन्वाकारड का इकतालीसवाँ सर्ग पूरा हुआ । न्न» ४४--- हि.चत्वारिशः सर्ग डा ६8--- अथ प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवस्तान्हरीन्टक्षिणां दिशम्‌ । अब्रवीन्मेघसङ्काशं सुषेणं नाम यूथपम्‌

verses.sloka: तारायाः पितरम् राजा श्वशुरम् भीम विक्रमम् ।अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् अभिगम्य प्रणम्य च ॥४-४२-२॥
verses.transliteration: tārāyāḥ pitaram rājā śvaśuram bhīma vikramam ।abravīt prāṁjaliḥ vākyam abhigamya praṇamya ca ॥4-42-2॥

translations.english: King (Sugriva) went with folded hands to Tara's father, his fatherinlaw, of terrifying valour, offered salutation and said:
translations.hindi: सुषेण, तारा के पिता थे और वालि के ससुर थे बड़े भयङ्कर विक्रमशाली थे । अतः सुम्रीच उनके पास जा, प्रणाम कर तथा हाथ जोड़ कर उनसे बोले

verses.sloka: महर्षि पुत्रम् मारीचम् अर्चिष्मन्तम् महाकपिम् ।वृ^इतम् कपिवरैः शूरैः महेन्द्र सदृ^इश द्युतिम् ॥४-४२-३॥
verses.transliteration: maharṣi putram mārīcam arciṣmantam mahākapim ।vṛ^itam kapivaraiḥ śūraiḥ mahendra sadṛ^iśa dyutim ॥4-42-3॥

translations.english: Sugriva spoke to the great lustrous monkey Archisman, son of the eminent sage Marichi who possessed the wisdom and prowess of Indra and was comparable to Vaineteya (Garuda) in lustre. He also spoke to the other sons of Maricha, called Marichas, who were very strong and known as Archismalas (garlands of continuous glow) and asked all of them to proceed in the western direction.
translations.hindi: मह मारीच के पुत्र अचिष्मान्‌ नामक महावानर से भी सुग्रीव ने कहा | यह वानर अति शूर था, इसके अनुयायी बहुत से वानर भी थे । इसका शरीर मद्देन्द्राचल की तरह बड़ा लगता चौड़ा था और इसके चेहरे पर तेज विराजमान था

verses.sloka: बुद्धि विक्रम सम्पन्नान् वैनतेय सम द्युतिम् ।मरीचि पुत्रान् मारीचान् अर्चिर्माल्यान् महबलान् ॥४-४२-४॥
verses.transliteration: buddhi vikrama sampannān vainateya sama dyutim ।marīci putrān mārīcān arcirmālyān mahabalān ॥4-42-4॥

translations.english: Sugriva spoke to the great lustrous monkey Archisman, son of the eminent sage Marichi who possessed the wisdom and prowess of Indra and was comparable to Vaineteya (Garuda) in lustre. He also spoke to the other sons of Maricha, called Marichas, who were very strong and known as Archismalas (garlands of continuous glow) and asked all of them to proceed in the western direction.

verses.sloka: ऋषि पुत्रान् च तान् सर्वान् प्रतीचीम् आदिशत् दिशम् ।द्वाभ्याम् शत सहस्राभ्याम् कपीनाम् कपि सत्तमाः ॥४-४२-५॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣi putrān ca tān sarvān pratīcīm ādiśat diśam ।dvābhyām śata sahasrābhyām kapīnām kapi sattamāḥ ॥4-42-5॥

translations.english: 'O foremost of monkeys with Sushena as your group leader accompanied by two hundred thousand vanaras, go and search for Vaidehi.
translations.hindi: यह बड़ा बुद्धिमान और पराक्रमी था और तेज चलने में गरुड़ के समान था । यह महषि मरीच का पुत्र था । ओर इसका नाम अर्चिष्मत्‌ था | यह देदीप्यमान माला पहिने हुए था ओर महाबलबान था ॥४) * ऋपिषुतरांश्च तान सर्वान प्रतीचीमादिशद्विशम्‌ । द्वाभ्यां शतसहस्राभ्यां कपीनां कपिसत्तमा!

verses.sloka: सुशेषण प्रमुखा यूयम् वैदेहीम् परिमार्गथ ।सौराष्ट्रान् सह बाह्लीकान् चंद्रचित्रान् तथैव च ॥४-४२-६॥
verses.transliteration: suśeṣaṇa pramukhā yūyam vaidehīm parimārgatha ।saurāṣṭrān saha bāhlīkān caṁdracitrān tathaiva ca ॥4-42-6॥

translations.english: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.

verses.sloka: स्फीतान् जन पदान् रम्यान् विपुलानि पुराणि च ।पुंनाग गहनम् कुक्षिम् वकुल उद्दालक आकुलम् ॥४-४२-७॥
verses.transliteration: sphītān jana padān ramyān vipulāni purāṇi ca ।puṁnāga gahanam kukṣim vakula uddālaka ākulam ॥4-42-7॥

translations.english: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.

verses.sloka: तथा केतक खंडान् च मार्गध्वम् हरि पुंगवाः ।प्रत्यक् स्रोतो वहाः चैव नद्यः शीतजलाः शिवाः ॥४-४२-८॥
verses.transliteration: tathā ketaka khaṁḍān ca mārgadhvam hari puṁgavāḥ ।pratyak sroto vahāḥ caiva nadyaḥ śītajalāḥ śivāḥ ॥4-42-8॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.

verses.sloka: तापसानाम् अरण्यानि कांतारा गिरयः च ये ।तत्र स्थलीः मरुप्राया अति उच्च शिखराः शिलाः ॥४-४२-९॥
verses.transliteration: tāpasānām araṇyāni kāṁtārā girayaḥ ca ye ।tatra sthalīḥ maruprāyā ati ucca śikharāḥ śilāḥ ॥4-42-9॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.

verses.sloka: गिरि जाल आवृताम् दुर्गाम् मार्गित्वा पश्चिमाम् दिशम् ।ततः पश्चिमम् आगम्य समुद्रम् द्रष्टुम् अर्हथ ॥४-४२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: giri jāla āvṛtām durgām mārgitvā paścimām diśam ।tataḥ paścimam āgamya samudram draṣṭum arhatha ॥4-42-10॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.

verses.sloka: तिमि नक्र आकुल जलम् गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः ।ततः केतक खंडेषु तमाल गहनेषु च ॥४-४२-११॥
verses.transliteration: timi nakra ākula jalam gatvā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ ।tataḥ ketaka khaṁḍeṣu tamāla gahaneṣu ca ॥4-42-11॥

translations.english: 'There the monkeys may roam about the Ketaka shrubs, tamala thickets and coconut groves.

verses.sloka: कपयो विहरिष्यन्ति नारिकेल वनेषु च ।तत्र सीताम् च मार्गध्वम् निलयम् रावणस्य च ॥४-४२-१२॥
verses.transliteration: kapayo vihariṣyanti nārikela vaneṣu ca ।tatra sītām ca mārgadhvam nilayam rāvaṇasya ca ॥4-42-12॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.
translations.hindi: इस समुद्र में बड़े बड़े तिभिङ्गल मच्छ ओर नादे Fe र नाके मगर भरे हुए हैँ । इस समुद्र के तटवर्ती केवडे ओर तमालों के बलों ना रै आर तमालो के अनं कपयो बिहरिष्यन्ति नारिकेलवनेषु च । र (९५७ है 3 तत्र सीतां च मागध्बं निलयं रावणस्य च

verses.sloka: वेलातल निवेष्टेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च ।मुरची पत्तनम् चैव रम्यम् चैव जटा पुरम् ॥४-४२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: velātala niveṣṭeṣu parvateṣu vaneṣu ca ।muracī pattanam caiva ramyam caiva jaṭā puram ॥4-42-13॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

verses.sloka: अवंतीम् अंगलेपाम् च तथा च अलक्षितम् वनम् ।राष्ट्राणि च विशालानि पत्तनानि ततः ततः ॥४-४२-१४॥
verses.transliteration: avaṁtīm aṁgalepām ca tathā ca alakṣitam vanam ।rāṣṭrāṇi ca viśālāni pattanāni tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-42-14॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

verses.sloka: सिंधु सागरयोः चैव संगमे तत्र पर्वतः ।महान् हेम गिरिः नाम शत शृंगो महाद्रुमः ॥४-४२-१५॥
verses.transliteration: siṁdhu sāgarayoḥ caiva saṁgame tatra parvataḥ ।mahān hema giriḥ nāma śata śṛṁgo mahādrumaḥ ॥4-42-15॥

translations.english: 'There is a lofty mountain with a hundred peaks and great trees at the confluence of river Sindhu and the sea. It is known as Hemagiri (golden mountain).
translations.hindi: जहाँ पर सिन्धु नद ऑर बड़े समुद्र का सङ्गम होता है, वदां पर एक पहाड़ है उसका नाम प्रगिरि और उस पर सो शिखर हें । उस पर एक बड़ा वृक्ष हे

verses.sloka: तत्र प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु सिंहाः पक्ष गमाः स्थिताः ।तिमि मत्स्य गजाम्ब् चैव नीडानि आरोपयन्ति ते ॥४-४२-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tatra prastheṣu ramyeṣu siṁhāḥ pakṣa gamāḥ sthitāḥ ।timi matsya gajāmb caiva nīḍāni āropayanti te ॥4-42-16॥

translations.english: 'On the slopes of that mountain you will find lions called Pakshagamas, that is lions with wings. They carry the whales, fishes and elephants from the sea to their shelters on the beautiful mountain slopes.
translations.hindi: सके रमणीकशिखर पर पक्षधारी सिंह हूँ, जो तिमि मच्छ जैसे वडे भारी जल जीवों और हाथियों को उठा करअपने घोंसलाँ ले जाते हैं

verses.sloka: तानि नीडानि सिंहानाम् गिरि शृंग गताः च ये ।दृप्ताः तृप्ताः च मातंगाः तोयद स्वन निःस्वनाः ॥४-४२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tāni nīḍāni siṁhānām giri śṛṁga gatāḥ ca ye ।dṛptāḥ tṛptāḥ ca mātaṁgāḥ toyada svana niḥsvanāḥ ॥4-42-17॥

translations.english: 'The proud elephants wandering on the mountain slopes, and on the vast tract filled with water would be happy trumpeting like thundering clouds. They roam in the caves of lions.
translations.hindi: इन सिंहो के घोंसले उसी पहाड के शिखरों पर बने हुए हें । इस पर्वत के चारों आर जल है। और इसी पवत के शिखर पर बड़े मोटे ताजे .मदमस्त गज, जो मेघ की तरह चिघारते हैँ घुमा फिरा करते हैं। उसका एक शिखर जो सुबणेमय आकाशस्पर्शी है और उसके ऊपर चित्रविचित्र पेड लगे हुए हैं

verses.sloka: विचरन्ति विशाले अस्मिन् तोय पूर्णे समन्ततः ।तस्य शृंगम् दिव स्पर्शम् कांचनम् चित्र पादपम् ॥४-४२-१८॥
verses.transliteration: vicaranti viśāle asmin toya pūrṇe samantataḥ ।tasya śṛṁgam diva sparśam kāṁcanam citra pādapam ॥4-42-18॥

translations.english: 'The monkeys capable of assuming any form at their will should search the scraping peaks of the golden mountain (Himagiri) with colourful trees without delay.

verses.sloka: सर्वम् आशु विचेतव्यम् कपिभिः काम रूपिभिः ।कोटिम् तत्र समुद्रे तु कांचनीम् शत योजनम् ॥४-४२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sarvam āśu vicetavyam kapibhiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ।koṭim tatra samudre tu kāṁcanīm śata yojanam ॥4-42-19॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys you will see the dazzling golden tip of a mountain called Pariyatra towards the end of the sea. It is extended over a hundred yojanas and dificult to gaze because of its brilliance.

verses.sloka: दुर्दर्शाम् पारियात्रस्य गता द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः ।कोट्यः तत्र चतुर्विम्शत् गंधर्वाणाम् तरस्विनाम् ॥४-४२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: durdarśām pāriyātrasya gatā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ ।koṭyaḥ tatra caturvimśat gaṁdharvāṇām tarasvinām ॥4-42-20॥

translations.english: 'There dwell twentyfour crore of terrific gandharvas blazing like fire who can assume any form.They lead an ascetic life.
translations.hindi: हे वानरो ! वहाँ जाने पर इस चोटी का देखना दुर्य म होने पर भो तुस लोग उसे देख स₹)गे। उस चोटी पर चौबीस करोड़ बड़े बलवान गन्धवे रहा करते हैं

verses.sloka: वसन्ति अग्नि निकाशानाम् घोराणाम् काम रूपिणाम् ।पावक अर्चिः प्रतीकाशाः समवेताः समन्ततः ॥४-४२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: vasanti agni nikāśānām ghorāṇām kāma rūpiṇām ।pāvaka arciḥ pratīkāśāḥ samavetāḥ samantataḥ ॥4-42-21॥

translations.english: 'Collected together in thousands, and radiating like fire, they live there. Even the very brave vanaras should not go close to them.
translations.hindi: बहाँ के रहने वाले गन्धर्व अग्नि की तमवच पाडे इच्छारूपधारी हैं। वे अप्रिशिखर की तरह प्रकाशित हो, चारों ओर घूमा करते हें

verses.sloka: न अति आसादयित्वाः ते वानरैः भीम विक्रमैः ।न अदेयम् च फलम् तस्मात् देशात् किम्चित् प्लवंगमैः ॥४-४२-२२॥
verses.transliteration: na ati āsādayitvāḥ te vānaraiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ ।na adeyam ca phalam tasmāt deśāt kimcit plavaṁgamaiḥ ॥4-42-22॥

translations.english: 'You should not pluck any fruits from those woods, for courageous gandharvas protect the fruits of the trees. It is difficult to go there, for those heroes have frightening bravery.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि तुम लोग भी. बड़े पराक्रमी हो, तथापि न तो उनके “पास जाना और न उनसे छेड़छाड़ ऊरना। वहाँ के फल भी मत लेना

verses.sloka: दुरासदा हि ते वीराः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।फल मूलानि ते तत्र रक्षन्ते भीम विक्रमाः ॥४-४२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: durāsadā hi te vīrāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ ।phala mūlāni te tatra rakṣante bhīma vikramāḥ ॥4-42-23॥

translations.english: 'You should not pluck any fruits from those woods, for courageous gandharvas protect the fruits of the trees. It is difficult to go there, for those heroes have frightening bravery.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि वहाँ के गन्धव बड़े बीर दुर्धर्ष और बलवान्‌ हैं / वे भीम पराक्रमी गन्धर्व, वहाँ जो फल हैं, उनकी रखवाली करते है

verses.sloka: तत्र यत्नः च कर्तव्यो मार्गितव्या च जानकी ।न हि तेभ्यो भयम् किंचित् कपित्वम् अनुवर्तताम् ॥४-४२-२४॥
verses.transliteration: tatra yatnaḥ ca kartavyo mārgitavyā ca jānakī ।na hi tebhyo bhayam kiṁcit kapitvam anuvartatām ॥4-42-24॥

translations.english: 'Exert yourself in your search for Janaki. Indeed there will be no fear from them, if you behave like normal monkeys in a natural way.

verses.sloka: तत्र वैदूर्य वर्णाभो वज्र संस्थान संस्थितः ।नाना द्रुम लता आकीर्णो वज्रः नाम महागिरिः ॥४-४२-२५॥
verses.transliteration: tatra vaidūrya varṇābho vajra saṁsthāna saṁsthitaḥ ।nānā druma latā ākīrṇo vajraḥ nāma mahāgiriḥ ॥4-42-25॥

translations.english: '(Beyond) there is a glorious mountain called Vajra of the colour of Vaidurya, hard as a diamond with different kinds of trees and vines.The mountain extends evenly to a stretch of a hundred yojanas.There are caves in the mountain where you may look for her with due effort.

verses.sloka: श्रीमान् समुदितः तत्र योजनानाम् शतम् समम् ।गुहाः तत्र विचेतव्याः प्रयत्नेन प्लवंगमाः ॥४-४२-२६॥
verses.transliteration: śrīmān samuditaḥ tatra yojanānām śatam samam ।guhāḥ tatra vicetavyāḥ prayatnena plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-42-26॥

translations.english: '(Beyond) there is a glorious mountain called Vajra of the colour of Vaidurya, hard as a diamond with different kinds of trees and vines.The mountain extends evenly to a stretch of a hundred yojanas.There are caves in the mountain where you may look for her with due effort.
translations.hindi: हे वांनरो ! वहाँ पर वैडूर्यमणि के रंग का और हीरे जैसी चमकवाला तथा अनेक प्रकार के पेड़ों से युक्त शतयोजन चौड़ा' ओर शोभायमान वज्र नाम का एक बड़ा पहाड़ है । उस पेत की सब गुफाएँ देखना ॥२::

verses.sloka: चतुर् भागे समुद्रस्य चक्रवान् नाम पर्वतः ।तत्र चक्रम् सहस्रारम् निर्मितम् विश्वकर्मणा ॥४-४२-२७॥
verses.transliteration: catur bhāge samudrasya cakravān nāma parvataḥ ।tatra cakram sahasrāram nirmitam viśvakarmaṇā ॥4-42-27॥

translations.english: 'Then move to the fourth part (of the western sea) where you will see a mountain called Chakravan occupying a quarter part of the sea.You will find there a thousandspiked wheel built by Visvakarma.

verses.sloka: तत्र पंचजनम् हत्वा हयग्रीवम् च दानवम् ।आजहार ततः चक्रम् शंखम् च पुरुषोत्तमः ॥४-४२-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tatra paṁcajanam hatvā hayagrīvam ca dānavam ।ājahāra tataḥ cakram śaṁkham ca puruṣottamaḥ ॥4-42-28॥

translations.english: 'It was there that the Supreme Lord Visnu, having slain Hayagriva and Panchajanam, recovered the discus and conch for himself.

verses.sloka: तस्य सानुषु रम्येषु विशालासु गुहासु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४२-२९॥
verses.transliteration: tasya sānuṣu ramyeṣu viśālāsu guhāsu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-42-29॥

translations.english: 'Look for Vaidehi and Ravana in the wide caves and colourful slopes of the (Chakravan) mountain.

verses.sloka: योजनानि चतुः षष्टिः वराहो नाम पर्वतः ।सुवर्ण शृंगः सुमहान् अगाधे वरुण आलये ॥४-४२-३०॥
verses.transliteration: yojanāni catuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ varāho nāma parvataḥ ।suvarṇa śṛṁgaḥ sumahān agādhe varuṇa ālaye ॥4-42-30॥

translations.english: 'Plunge deep down into the sea and you will see a goldenpeaked mountain called Varaha, the residence of Varuna.It is extended over sixty four yojanas in the sea.

verses.sloka: तत्र प्राक् ज्योतिषम् नाम जातरूपमयम् पुरम् ।यस्मिन् वसति दुष्ट आत्मा नरको नाम दानवः ॥४-४२-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tatra prāk jyotiṣam nāma jātarūpamayam puram ।yasmin vasati duṣṭa ātmā narako nāma dānavaḥ ॥4-42-31॥

translations.english: 'On the (Varaha) mountain is the city called Pragjyotisha, which is full of gold.There lives the evilminded demon Naraka.
translations.hindi: इसके आगे अगाध समुद्र में साठ योजन की ऊँचाई वाला झुबर्ण शिखर वाला वराह नाम का एक बड़ा सुन्दर पर्वत हे १!३०।। १ चदुर्भागे-चतुर्यमागे । ( गोऽ ) २ समुद्रस्य-लबणतमुद्रसप । शू र tt ० ) तत्र प्रार्ण्योतिषं नाम जातरूपमयं पुरम । यस्मिन्‌ बसति दुष्टात्मा नरको नाम दानवः

verses.sloka: तत्र सानुषु रम्येषु विशालासु गुहासु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४२-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tatra sānuṣu ramyeṣu viśālāsu guhāsu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-42-32॥

translations.english: 'There all over the wonderful slopes and wide caves look for Vaidehi and Ravana.

verses.sloka: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् कांचनान् अन्तर दर्शनम् ।पर्वतः सर्व सौवर्णो धारा प्रस्रवण आयुतः ॥४-४२-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tam atikramya śailendram kāṁcanān antara darśanam ।parvataḥ sarva sauvarṇo dhārā prasravaṇa āyutaḥ ॥4-42-33॥

translations.english: Beyond that lord of mountains lies an all-golden mountain, its caves gilded within and abounding in cascading waterfalls.

verses.sloka: तम् गजाः च वराहाः च सिंहा व्याघ्राः च सर्वतः ।अभिगर्जन्ति सततम् तेन शब्देन दर्पिताः ॥४-४२-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tam gajāḥ ca varāhāḥ ca siṁhā vyāghrāḥ ca sarvataḥ ।abhigarjanti satatam tena śabdena darpitāḥ ॥4-42-34॥

translations.english: On every side elephants, boars, lions and tigers, made proud by their own roaring, ceaselessly roar there.

verses.sloka: यस्मिन् हरि हयः श्रीमान् महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः ।अभिषिक्तः सुरै राजा मेघो नाम स पर्वतः ॥४-४२-३५॥
verses.transliteration: yasmin hari hayaḥ śrīmān mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ।abhiṣiktaḥ surai rājā megho nāma sa parvataḥ ॥4-42-35॥

translations.english: 'Possessor of tawny horses, king Indra who killed demon Pakasasana was consecrated by gods at this mountain since known as Meghavan.

verses.sloka: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् महेन्द्र परिपालितम् ।षष्टिम् गिरि सहस्राणि कांचनानि गमिष्यथ ॥४-४२-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tam atikramya śailendram mahendra paripālitam ।ṣaṣṭim giri sahasrāṇi kāṁcanāni gamiṣyatha ॥4-42-36॥

translations.english: 'On crossing the hill ruled by Indra you will reach the rows of sixty thousand mountains of gold shining like the brilliance of the rising Sun. The mountains glow with golden trees filled with bloom.

verses.sloka: तरुण आदित्य वर्णानि भ्राजमानानि सर्वतः ।जातरूपमयैः वृक्षैः शोभितानि सुपुष्पितैः ॥४-४२-३७॥
verses.transliteration: taruṇa āditya varṇāni bhrājamānāni sarvataḥ ।jātarūpamayaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ śobhitāni supuṣpitaiḥ ॥4-42-37॥

translations.english: 'On crossing the hill ruled by Indra you will reach the rows of sixty thousand mountains of gold shining like the brilliance of the rising Sun. The mountains glow with golden trees filled with bloom.
translations.hindi: उस पहाड़ पर सुघर, सिंह, व्याघ्रादि जंगली जानवर सदा ही अपनी बोली की प्रतिध्वनि पुन और अहङ्कार से पुक्क हा, गजा करते हैँ

verses.sloka: तेषाम् मध्ये स्थितो राजा मेरुः उत्तम पर्वतः ।आदित्येन प्रसन्नेन शैलो दत्त वरः पुरा ॥४-४२-३८॥
verses.transliteration: teṣām madhye sthito rājā meruḥ uttama parvataḥ ।ādityena prasannena śailo datta varaḥ purā ॥4-42-38॥

translations.english: 'In the midst of the sixty thousand hills stands Meru, King of mountains. It is the northern mountain, blessed by the Sungod with a boon in the past.
translations.hindi: इनके मध्य में सुमेरु नामक पकेतराज्ञ है । सूर्य ने असन्न हो इरं इसको यह वरदान दिआ है कि, तुम्हारे आश्रित जो पर्वत रहँगे वे भी मेरी कृपा से, क्या दिन में ओर क्या रात मै छदा छुनहले देख षड्गे

verses.sloka: तेन एवम् उक्तः शैलेन्द्रः सर्व एव त्वत् आश्रयाः ।मत् प्रसादात् भविष्यन्ति दिवा रात्रौ च कांचनाः ॥४-४२-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tena evam uktaḥ śailendraḥ sarva eva tvat āśrayāḥ ।mat prasādāt bhaviṣyanti divā rātrau ca kāṁcanāḥ ॥4-42-39॥

translations.english: 'The Sungod said to mount Meru, 'By my grace all the trees and hillocks of this king of mountains will shine in golden red, the gods, gandharvas and demons who dwell here will have golden radiance '.

verses.sloka: त्वयि ये च अपि वत्स्यन्ति देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ।ते भविष्यन्ति भक्ताः च प्रभया कांचन प्रभाः ॥४-४२-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tvayi ye ca api vatsyanti deva gandharva dānavāḥ ।te bhaviṣyanti bhaktāḥ ca prabhayā kāṁcana prabhāḥ ॥4-42-40॥

translations.english: 'The Sungod said to mount Meru, 'By my grace all the trees and hillocks of this king of mountains will shine in golden red, the gods, gandharvas and demons who dwell here will have golden radiance '.

verses.sloka: विश्वेदेवाः च वसवो मरुतः च दिव ओकसः ।आगत्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् मेरुम् उत्तम पर्वतम् ॥४-४२-४१॥
verses.transliteration: viśvedevāḥ ca vasavo marutaḥ ca diva okasaḥ ।āgatya paścimām saṁdhyām merum uttama parvatam ॥4-42-41॥

translations.english: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.
translations.hindi: इस परवत पर विश्वेदेव, बसु, और मरुत तथा अन्यदेव सायं सन्ध्या के समय आ कर सूर्यदेव की उपासना करते हें । सूयं देवता उनसे पूजे जा कर और सब जीवों की दृष्टि से अदृश्य हो 'झस्ताचलगासी होते हैं

verses.sloka: आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ति तैः च सूर्यो अभिपूजितः ।अदृश्यः सर्व भूतानाम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम् ॥४-४२-४२॥
verses.transliteration: ādityam upatiṣṭhanti taiḥ ca sūryo abhipūjitaḥ ।adṛśyaḥ sarva bhūtānām astam gacchati parvatam ॥4-42-42॥

translations.english: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.

verses.sloka: योजनानाम् सहस्राणि दश तानि दिवाकरः ।मुहूर्त अर्धेन तम् शीघ्रम् अभियाति शिल उच्चयम् ॥४-४२-४३॥
verses.transliteration: yojanānām sahasrāṇi daśa tāni divākaraḥ ।muhūrta ardhena tam śīghram abhiyāti śila uccayam ॥4-42-43॥

translations.english: 'Crossing ten thousand yojanas swiftly in half a moment, the Sun touches the mount behind which he sets.

verses.sloka: शृंगे तस्य महत् दिव्यम् भवनम् सूर्य संनिभम् ।प्रासाद गण संबाधम् विहितम् विश्वकर्मणा ॥४-४२-४४॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṁge tasya mahat divyam bhavanam sūrya saṁnibham ।prāsāda gaṇa saṁbādham vihitam viśvakarmaṇā ॥4-42-44॥

translations.english: 'There is a great divine abode glowing like the Sungod on the peak of the mountain.It is a cluster of mansions built by Visvakarma.
translations.hindi: इख पंत के शिखर पर बड़ा दिव्य, सूये क लमान चस झाला कई खलों ( सजिलो ) बाला भवन, -विश्वकर्मो का बनाया हुआ हे

verses.sloka: शोभितम् तरुभिः चित्रैः नाना पक्षि समाकुलैः ।निकेतम् पाश हस्तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः ॥४-४२-४५॥
verses.transliteration: śobhitam tarubhiḥ citraiḥ nānā pakṣi samākulaiḥ ।niketam pāśa hastasya varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ ॥4-42-45॥

translations.english: 'It is the residence of Varuna, who holds the noose in his hand.It is an enchanting place, full of trees attracting flocks of various birds.
translations.hindi: बह साँति भाँति के चित्रविचित्र वृक्षों पक्षियों से परिपूण है । यह दी पाशह्दरत वरुण जी का स्थान है

verses.sloka: अन्तरा मेरुम् अस्तम् च तालो दश शिरा महान् ।जातरूपमयः श्रीमान् भ्राजते चित्र वेदिकः ॥४-४२-४६॥
verses.transliteration: antarā merum astam ca tālo daśa śirā mahān ।jātarūpamayaḥ śrīmān bhrājate citra vedikaḥ ॥4-42-46॥

translations.english: 'Between mount Asta (the mountain behind which the Sun sets) and Meru there is a shining golden palm tree with ten high peaks and wonderful altars around.
translations.hindi: आगे मेरु ओर अस्ताचल के बीच में दश डांलयों का, कि किटी ५ ¢ सुबण'मय, अत्यन्त मनोहर ओर विचित्र वेदिकायुक्त एक ताल का पेड़ है

verses.sloka: तेषु सर्वेषु दुर्गेषु सरस्सु च सरित्सु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४२-४७॥
verses.transliteration: teṣu sarveṣu durgeṣu sarassu ca saritsu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-42-47॥

translations.english: 'Look for Vaidehi and Ravana all over those inaccessible mountains, lakes and rivers.

verses.sloka: यत्र तिष्ठति धर्मज्ञः तपसा स्वेन भावितः ।मेरु सावर्णिर् इति एष ख्यातो वै ब्रह्मणा समः ॥४-४२-४८॥
verses.transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhati dharmajñaḥ tapasā svena bhāvitaḥ ।meru sāvarṇir iti eṣa khyāto vai brahmaṇā samaḥ ॥4-42-48॥

translations.english: 'The sage Merusavarna, knower of dharma, famous for his penance and comparable to Brahma lives there with him on Meru.

verses.sloka: प्रष्टव्यो मेरुसावर्णिः महर्षिः सूर्य संनिभः ।प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रवृत्तिम् मैथिलीम् प्रति ॥४-४२-४९॥
verses.transliteration: praṣṭavyo merusāvarṇiḥ maharṣiḥ sūrya saṁnibhaḥ ।praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pravṛttim maithilīm prati ॥4-42-49॥

translations.english: 'Bow down, touch the feet of the seer Merusavarna, who glows like the Sun and then enquire from him about Sita.

verses.sloka: एतावत् जीव लोकस्य भास्करो रजनी क्षये ।कृत्वा वितिमिरम् सर्वम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम् ॥४-४२-५०॥
verses.transliteration: etāvat jīva lokasya bhāskaro rajanī kṣaye ।kṛtvā vitimiram sarvam astam gacchati parvatam ॥4-42-50॥

translations.english: 'The world of living beings is extended to this extent. The Sun dispels darkness at the end of the night and thereafter reaches the mountain behind which he sets (at the end of the day).
translations.hindi: एतावज्जीवलोकस्य भास्करो रजनीक्षये । ५. ° ७ कृत्वा वितिमिरं सवमस्तं गच्छति पर्वतम्‌ ॥५ ०] चा स्ट कल्टडः + बे द्विचत्वारिश: सगः ४२३. बस यहीं तक जोवलोऊ में, रात के बीत जाने पर, सूर्य नारायण उदयाचल पवत से मेहसावर्शि तक अन्धकार का नाश. कर, अस्ताचल को चले जाते है

verses.sloka: एतावत् वानरैः शक्यम् गन्तुम् वानर पुंगवाः ।अभास्करम् अमर्यादम् न जानीमः ततः परम् ॥४-४२-५१॥
verses.transliteration: etāvat vānaraiḥ śakyam gantum vānara puṁgavāḥ ।abhāskaram amaryādam na jānīmaḥ tataḥ param ॥4-42-51॥

translations.english: 'O great monkeys you can go only up to that point. The Sun's rays do not extend beyond this and it has no boundaries.We do not know about the area beyond this limit.
translations.hindi: है वानरोत्तम ! बम यहीं तक वानर पण जा सकते हैँ | इससे" आगे का हाल सूर्य का प्रकाश न होने तथा भूभाग को मर्यादा (का पा ) न होने के कारण, मुझे नहीं मालूम

verses.sloka: अवगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च ।अस्तम् पर्वतम् आसाद्य पूर्णे मासे निवर्तत ॥४-४२-५२॥
verses.transliteration: avagamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca ।astam parvatam āsādya pūrṇe māse nivartata ॥4-42-52॥

translations.english: 'Go and find out Sita and the abode of Ravana. After this, return to the mountain behind which the Sun sets and come back on completion of a month.
translations.hindi: तुम लोग अस्ताचल सक जा कर, सीता का तथा रावण के आवासस्थात का पता लगा कर, एक मास पूरा होते होते लौट आना

verses.sloka: ऊर्ध्वम् मासान् न वस्तव्यम् वसन् वध्यो भवेन् मम ।सह एव शूरो युष्माभिः श्वशुरो मे गमिष्यति ॥४-४२-५३॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvam māsān na vastavyam vasan vadhyo bhaven mama ।saha eva śūro yuṣmābhiḥ śvaśuro me gamiṣyati ॥4-42-53॥

translations.english: 'If you tarry beyond a month, you will be slain. My fatherin law, the brave hero will go with your group.

verses.sloka: श्रोतव्यम् सर्वम् एतस्य भवद्भिः दिष्ट कारिभिः ।गुरुः एष महाबाहुः श्वशुरो मे महाबलः ॥४-४२-५४॥
verses.transliteration: śrotavyam sarvam etasya bhavadbhiḥ diṣṭa kāribhiḥ ।guruḥ eṣa mahābāhuḥ śvaśuro me mahābalaḥ ॥4-42-54॥

translations.english: 'You should obey him. You are meant to carry out his orders. He is not only my fatherinlaw but also a valiant, strong and powerful hero and my preceptor.
translations.hindi: त: आप सच उने कहने में चलता। जो कुळ यह ऊहे, सुनना । क्योंकि मेरे यह महावाहु ससुर पूज्य हैं और सहाबलवान्‌ ह॥५५! १४२४ किष्किन्धाकाण्डे विक्र ७ (A भवन्सश्चापि विक्रान्ताः प्रमाण सवकर्मसु । प्र माणमेनं संस्थाप्य पश्यध्वं पश्चिमां दिशम्‌ ॥ ५५ यद्यपि आप लोग भी एराक्रमी ओर सब कार्या की व्यवस्था करने बाले हैं, तथापि आप इनको अपना व्यवस्थापक बना कर पश्चिम दिशा में सीता ओर रावण के आवासस्थान' की खोज का कार्यं करना

verses.sloka: भवन्तः च अपि विक्रान्ताः प्रमाणम् सर्वे एव हि ।प्रमाणम् एनम् संस्थाप्य पश्यध्वम् पश्चिमाम् दिशम् ॥४-४२-५५॥
verses.transliteration: bhavantaḥ ca api vikrāntāḥ pramāṇam sarve eva hi ।pramāṇam enam saṁsthāpya paśyadhvam paścimām diśam ॥4-42-55॥

translations.english: 'My fatherinlaw will be your leader. His authority will be final in all matters. Accept his authority and look for Vaidehi in the western direction.

verses.sloka: दृष्टायाम् तु नरेन्द्रस्या पत्न्याम् अमित तेजसः ।कृत कृत्या भविष्यामः कृतस्य प्रतिकर्मणा ॥४-४२-५६॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭāyām tu narendrasyā patnyām amita tejasaḥ ।kṛta kṛtyā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtasya pratikarmaṇā ॥4-42-56॥

translations.english: "When the wife of the lord of men of measureless splendour has been found, we shall have accomplished our purpose by requiting what was done for us."
translations.hindi: इन अतुलित तेजसम्पन्न नरेन्द्र श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की भायों का चता लगा देने से हम सब कृतक़्त्य हो जाँटगे ओर इनके उपकार का बदला भी चुक जायगा

verses.sloka: अतो अन्यत् अपि यत् कार्यम् कार्यस्य अस्य प्रियम् भवेत् ।संप्रधार्य भवद्भिः च देश काल अर्थ संहितम् ॥४-४२-५७॥
verses.transliteration: ato anyat api yat kāryam kāryasya asya priyam bhavet ।saṁpradhārya bhavadbhiḥ ca deśa kāla artha saṁhitam ॥4-42-57॥

translations.english: "Whatever else beyond this is to be done, and may be conducive to this task, is to be determined by your honours as suits the place, the time and the purpose."

verses.sloka: ततः सुषेण प्रमुखाः प्लवंगमाःसुग्रीव वाक्यम् निपुणम् निशम्य ।आमंत्र्य सर्वे प्लवगाधिपम् तेजग्मुर् दिशम् ताम् वरुण अभिगुप्ताम् ॥४-४२-५८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suṣeṇa pramukhāḥ plavaṁgamāḥsugrīva vākyam nipuṇam niśamya ।āmaṁtrya sarve plavagādhipam tejagmur diśam tām varuṇa abhiguptām ॥4-42-58॥

translations.english: Then all those monkeys headed by Sushena, having heard the shrewd word of Sugriva, took leave of the lord of monkeys and went to that quarter which is guarded by Varuna.
